Consult Summary:
- 26-year-old woman with new onset dry, itchy, red skin on arms and hands, likely contact dermatitis following recent swimming.

History:
- Presenting complaint: Dry, itchy, red skin on arms and hands started a few days ago.
- Onset/Progression: Sudden onset a few days ago, noted after swimming; no previous similar episodes.
- Associated symptoms: No cracking, spots, fever, sweating, vomiting, loose stools, appetite or urinary symptoms. Reports tiredness; otherwise well.
- Exacerbating/relieving factors: Coconut butter used for past few days without improvement.
- Past medical history: No previous skin conditions (eczema, dermatitis) reported.
- Medications: Microgynon (dose/route/frequency not documented); no other medications.
- Allergies: Possible lactose intolerance; no documented medication or food allergies.
- Family history: Father has asthma, mother has hayfever; no known family skin conditions.
- Social history: Lives alone; primary school teacher; recent increased work stress; non-smoker; does not drink alcohol or use recreational drugs.
- Preventive care: Not mentioned.

Examination:
- No physical examination performed or findings documented.
- Vitals: Not documented.

Impression:
- Likely contact dermatitis following swimming; possible contribution from stress.

Plan:
- Provide patient information leaflet on dermatitis.
- Recommend topical steroid cream (name/dose/route/frequency not documented) for inflammation.
- Advise use of emollients for dry skin, applied throughout the day for several days.
- Suggest over-the-counter antihistamines (Piriton, Loratadine; dose/route/frequency not documented) for itching.
- Advise against paracetamol and painkillers for this condition.
- Advise follow-up if no improvement within a week.

Quality checks:
●	Missing elements: Allergies not fully clarified; medication reconciliation may be incomplete (no dose or frequency documented for Microgynon); no examination or vitals performed/documented.
●	Internal conflicts: None noted.
●	Transcript quality: Clear with minimal extraneous/noisy content.
